source.read_mode: gzip stream of fcd_*.xml.gz and tripinfo_*.xml.gz; plain .xml was not read

definitions.primary_population: tripinfo rows with depart in [0, 86400), arrival >= depart, empty vaporized, and duration == arrival - depart
definitions.unfinished: vaporized=end or arrival < 0; excluded from primary duration and crossing rates
definitions.fcd_duration: last_seen_time - first_seen_time, one state per vehicle id
definitions.bins: left-closed and right-open, except the final bin includes every duration >= 7200 seconds
definitions.boundary: count of k*step such that depart < k*step < arrival and 0 < k*step < 86400
definitions.boundary_exact_endpoint: a trip that starts or ends exactly on a boundary does not cross that boundary
definitions.outside_time: arrival minus the end of the left-closed departure segment, floored at zero
